title: Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine Catalogue Row
seoTitle: Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine | Pinjin 5 m³/h
description: Xingtai 380 V hydraulic concrete spraying machine lists dual copper motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm and 100 m / 50 m, 295 kg. It is not the 7 m³/h high-flow sprayer, not M9 plaster, not a diesel sprayer and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.

answerBlock.what: This Xingtai hydraulic concrete spraying machine is a 380 V dual-motor unit listing 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm and 100 m / 50 m, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm, 295 kg. It is not a trailer concrete pump, not the 7 m³/h high-flow sprayer, not the M9 plaster sprayer and not a diesel sprayer. Quote only; no list price.
answerBlock.who: Contractors matching 5 m³/h, ≤8 mm particle and 380 V dual-motor supply to a spraying job whose hose stays inside 100 m / 50 m.
factors: 380 V for the listed 7.5/9 kW dual motors

faqs.question: Can I pump 1–3 cm stone with this sprayer?
faqs.answer: No. This hydraulic row lists particle ≤8 mm. 1–3 cm stone belongs on a trailer pump such as Electric 15 or Electric 30.

faqs.question: When do I open the high-flow hydraulic sprayer?
faqs.answer: The high-flow unit lists 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and 650 kg. Use that page when 7 m³/h or 150 m / 70 m is the printed window you need.
